# MCP tool catalog

**Generated by `npm run docs:tools` — do not hand-edit.**

133 tools, grouped by the module that registers them.

`confirm` marks a tool that refuses to act without `confirm: true` — the
destructive ones. A refusal answers PROSE, not JSON, so an agent parsing every
response as JSON will fail on one.

How a tool is written, and what disqualifies a handler from becoming one, is in
[mcp-tool-authoring](../../.claude/skills/mcp-tool-authoring/SKILL.md). What the
server IS — transport, lifecycle, scoping, security — is in
[mcp-server.md](mcp-server.md).

| `remove_block_from_library` | **confirm** | Remove (delete) a block from the DA.live authoring library — the inverse of promote_block_to_library. Removes the component-definition.json entry, deletes the doc page, drops the sheet row, commits/pu |
| `sync_storefront` |  | Git add, commit, and push changes in the storefront directory |
